page.overview:
Who is Nuja of Lomar?

Nuja of Lomar is a ficitonal character created by American author Jason Scott Aiken and included in several of his sword-and-sorcery short stories. She appears to have been at least partially inspired by the Robert E. Howard character Red Sonja.

Nuja is a statuesque and beautiful warrior-woman hailing from the ancient land of Lomar. She wears her red hair long, carries a steel greatsword, and dresses in silver armour. She also appears to be a protector of sorts for her homeland, and may be somehow affiliated with the Great Old One Tsathoggua.

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Humans
